The official Kubernetes site indicates that 1.37 is the current minor release series, but the results don't confirm the latest patch number.

- **Official docs:** The kubernetes.io release page lists 1.37.0 (Released on 2026-08-26) as the latest patch release for the 1.37 series, which is marked as actively supported.
- **Upcoming patch:** The same page schedules 1.37.1 with a target date of 2026-09-15. That date has already passed, so 1.37.1 or a later patch has probably shipped, but I couldn't confirm it from these results.
- **Conflicting source:** A third-party tracker (versionlog.com) shows 1.36.2 Released 11 Jun 2026 as the latest stable version, with 1.37.0 alphas as the pre-release. That page appears to be a stale snapshot from before 1.37.0 shipped, so I'd rely on the official site.

Bottom line: the latest minor release is Kubernetes 1.37 (released August 26, 2026). For the exact current patch version, check kubernetes.io/releases or the GitHub changelog.

content.text:
The latest minor release is **Kubernetes 1.37 ("Garhwal")**, released August 26, 2026.

I couldn't confirm the current patch version. The official release page shows 1.37.0 as the latest patch, with 1.37.1 scheduled for September 15. That date has passed, so 1.37.1 or a later patch has probably shipped. You can check kubernetes.io/releases or the GitHub changelog for the exact number.

One third-party tracker (versionlog.com) still lists 1.36.2 as the latest stable. It looks like an outdated snapshot, so I went with the official site.

Sources:
- [Kubernetes 1.37: Garhwal](https://kubernetes.io/releases/1.37/)
- [Kubernetes releases (kubernetes.io)](https://kubernetes.io/de/releases/_print/)
- [versionlog.com Kubernetes](https://versionlog.com/kubernetes/)
